# OpenCode floating model menu

`tui-opencode-model-menu.vt` contains 39,456 byte-exact output bytes from the
installed OpenCode 2.0.32 renderer in an isolated ConPTY on 2026-11-02.
SHA256: `F27688033B6B29F46D6F8D46346E365AD30B387D28A0AE3BDE6B805CDC993240`.

The private configuration defines three local fixture model names. No prompt
was submitted to a model, no model or tool was invoked, and external access
was disabled. User profiles, history, sessions and credentials were not used.
The owned process was terminated after the capture. The capture helper and its
private configuration are in `target/opencode-ui/capture/` and `isolated/`.

The UI inputs open `/models` (completion Enter, then command Enter), move Down,
and close with Escape. After closing, ConPTY and the replay model resize from
110x36 to 80x24; the same menu is opened and closed in that smaller viewport.
Resize the replay model at exclusive byte end 25,319, before feeding the next
bytes. Each VT file generated by the helper was cumulative; this fixture is
the final cumulative stream.

| Phase | Exclusive byte end | Grid |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Startup | 13,587 | 110x36 |
| Slash completion | 13,845 | 110x36 |
| Floating model menu | 19,449 | 110x36 |
| Next selected item | 19,702 | 110x36 |
| Closed menu | 25,319 | 110x36 |
| Resized startup | 32,287 | 80x24 |
| Slash completion | 32,543 | 80x24 |
| Floating model menu | 35,897 | 80x24 |
| Closed menu | 39,456 | 80x24 |

The menu has a dominant dimmed neutral canvas, a brighter neutral floating
panel, and a single 58-cell orange selection strip. Pixel tests exercise the
actual GDI renderer at all menu/navigation/close endpoints. The palette is
presentation only; source text, attributes and coordinates remain exact.
